summary_en: For the Episcopal Conference of England and Wales the solemnities of the Ascension and of the Epiphany are assigned to their proper days (the fortieth day after Easter and 6 January); when the Epiphany falls on a Saturday it is assigned to the following Sunday, when on a Monday to the preceding Sunday. The date is printed "4 aug. 2107", evidently a misprint for 2017, transcribed as printed; this act restores holy days of obligation to their proper days.
excerpt: Angliae et Cambriae: sollemnitates in Ascensione Domini et in Epiphania Domini diebus illis propriis assignantur, scilicet quadragesima post Pascha et 6 ianuarii. Si vero sollemnitas in Epiphania Domini in sabbato occurrat sequenti diei dominicae assignetur; si vero in feria secunda dominicae praecedenti (4 aug. 2107; Prot. 180/17).

summary_en: For the Episcopal Conference of Poland variations in the Calendar of the dioceses of Poland are approved.

summary_en: For the Episcopal Conference of Rwanda the solemnity of All Saints is transferred from 1 November to the first Sunday of November, and the Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed, when it falls on a Sunday, to the Monday after that Sunday (two celebrations: AllSaints and AllSouls).
excerpt: Ruandae: translatio sollemnitatis Omnium Sanctorum a die 1ª mensis novembris ad I dominicam eiusdem mensis et Commemorationis Omnium Fidelium Defunctorum, si in dominica occurrat, ad feriam II post eandem dominicam (18 ian. 2017; Prot. 467/16).

summary_en: For the Episcopal Conference of Scotland the solemnities of Saints Peter and Paul and of the Assumption, when they fall on a Saturday, are assigned to the following Sunday and, when on a Monday, to the preceding Sunday; the solemnity of All Saints, when on a Saturday, is assigned to the following Sunday and, when on a Monday, is a holy day of obligation (three celebrations named; touches holy days of obligation).
excerpt: Scotiae: sollemnitates Ss. Petri et Pauli, apostolorum, et in Assumptione beatae Mariae Virginis, si in sabbato occurrant sequenti diei dominicae assignentur; si vero in feria secunda dominicae praecedenti. Sollemnitas Omnium Sanctorum, si in sabbato occurrat, sequenti diei dominicae assignetur; si vero in feria secunda, sit de praecepto (28 oct. 2017; Prot. 142/17).
